name: Iput
description: The youngest, most fleet-footed vizier of the Temple of Strength, who brings news that Rhonas is dead.

timeline.summary: Hapatra and the other viziers anxiously await word of the new gods on the steps of the Temple of Strength.
timeline.quote: We should have news of the new gods' intentions by now,

timeline.summary: Iput returns in tears and announces that the scorpion god killed Rhonas and means to kill them all.
timeline.quote: The scorpion god killed him. It means to kill them all.

pages_say.description: The youngest, most fleet-footed vizier of the Temple of Strength, who brings news that Rhonas is dead.
